question: The ratio between the perimeter and the breadth of a rectangle is 5 ∶ 1. If the area of the rectangle is 216 sq. cm what is the length of the rectangle?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Perimeter (P) to Breadth (B) is 5 : 1 ⇒ P = 5B

We know P = 2(L + B) ⇒ 2(L + B) = 5B ⇒ 2L = 3B ⇒ L : B = 3 : 2

Let Length = 3x and Breadth = 2x.

Area = 3x × 2x = 6x² = 216 ⇒ x² = 36 ⇒ x = 6

Length = 3x = 3 × 6 = 18 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 18 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of perimeter to breadth = 5 : 1

Area of the rectangle = 216 sq. cm

**Formulas Used:**

Perimeter of rectangle = 2(L + B)

Area of rectangle = L × B

 
 Length (L)
 Breadth (B)
 Area = 216 sq. cm

**Calculations:**

⇒ Perimeter / Breadth = 5 / 1

⇒ 2(L + B) / B = 5

⇒ 2L + 2B = 5B

⇒ 2L = 3B

⇒ L / B = 3 / 2

⇒ Let Length (L) = 3x and Breadth (B) = 2x

⇒ Area = L × B = 216

⇒ 3x × 2x = 216

⇒ 6x² = 216

⇒ x² = 216 ÷ 6 = 36

⇒ x = √36 = 6

⇒ Length = 3x = 3 × 6 = 18 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 18 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Perimeter of a Rectangle

The total distance around the outside of a rectangle. It is given by P = 2(L + B), where L is the length and B is the breadth.

Area of a Rectangle

The total space enclosed within the boundary of a rectangle. It is calculated as Area = L × B.

Diagonal of a Rectangle

A straight line connecting the opposite corners of a rectangle. It is calculated using the Pythagoras theorem: Diagonal = √(L² + B²).
